name: Adare Manor
positioning: Neo-Gothic 19th-century manor house hotel on an 840-acre estate in the village of Adare, County Limerick, with a golf course redesigned by Tom Fazio
best_for: Golfers, including those planning around the 2027 Ryder Cup
Travelers interested in Irish country-house history and architecture
Families who want estate activities or a self-catering cottage

facts.text: Adare Manor is in the village of Adare, County Limerick, 25 minutes from Shannon Airport, on the Wild Atlantic Way.
The estate covers 840 acres of parkland.
Construction of the current manor house began in 1832 and continued for over 30 years, completing in the 1860s.
The manor was built by the Quin family, later the Earls of Dunraven, led by the 2nd Earl and his wife Lady Caroline Wyndham.
The Gallery was the largest domestic room of its age in Ireland.
Head Chef Michael Tweedie leads The Oak Room's seasonal menu of Irish artisan ingredients.
Ōku is the estate's newest restaurant, a Japanese sushi experience.
Afternoon tea is served in The Gallery.
The golf course was redesigned by golf architect Tom Fazio.
Estate activities include falconry, archery, axe throwing, clay pigeon shooting, fishing, cycling and horse and carriage tours.
The Padel Club has a swimming pool, gym, studio and padel courts.
The estate has a private cinema that shows a History of Adare Manor film.

highlights.text: The Dunraven Staterooms were once the private apartments of the Earls of Dunraven and their families, in the historic Manor House.
Adare Manor will host the Ryder Cup from 13 to 19 September 2027.
The Spa was the first in Ireland to offer customised facial and body treatments with 111SKIN products.
Rose and Lavender Cottages are two three-bedroom self-catering cottages next to The Carriage House, a three-minute walk from the Manor House.
A self-guided architecture and garden audio tour has versions for adults and for children aged 6 to 12.

considerations.text: The golf course typically operates from late May through mid-October.
Spa treatments should be booked when booking the stay or at least four to six weeks ahead.
Most estate activities are reserved for guests staying at Adare Manor.
